title: Cause and Result in an Inflation Analysis

sections.title: What you know: cause and result
sections.content: You know *emiatt* and *következtében* from B1 Unit 16 and relative clauses with *aki* and *ami* from A2 Unit 4. In an inflation analysis *ami* can refer to the whole clause before it: `A bérek gyorsan nőnek, ami az árakat is növeli.` (Wages rise fast, which also raises prices.)

sections.title: What this lesson adds
sections.content: The terms of the price discussion. A *költségoldali sokk* means that costs rise first; *keresleti nyomás* means that buyers push prices up. *Lehorgonyzott várakozások* (anchored expectations) means that people believe the central bank will keep inflation steady.

sections.title: Patterns in Context
rows: A maginfláció az élelmiszerek és az energia ára nélkül mutatja az árak változását.
Core inflation shows the change in prices without food and energy.
A bérek nőnek, ami az árakat is növeli: ez az ár-bér spirál.
Wages rise, which also raises prices: this is the price-wage spiral.
A dezinfláció azt jelenti, hogy az árak lassabban nőnek.
Disinflation means that prices rise more slowly.
